The validity period of a G permit (which is typically a residence permit for employment purposes) when tied to a fixed-term employment contract of more than one year depends on the specific regulations of the country in question. Since immigration laws vary significantly by country, I cannot provide a definitive answer without knowing your location.

However, in many countries, the G permit is generally linked to the duration of the employment contract. If the fixed-term contract is for more than one year, the G permit is usually granted for the duration of that contract. If the contract is renewed or extended, the permit can also be extended accordingly.

To get an accurate answer, you would need to:

1. Identify the country where you are seeking this permit.
2. Consult the immigration or labor authority of that country for specific guidelines.

If you can provide the country, I can help you better.
